head: Personalized children's book made with AI, printed as a hardcover
dek: papergarden is a new website that writes and illustrates a picture book with your child as the hero, then sells it as an eBook for €9.95 or a hardcover for €39 plus shipping.
details: You pick an age group from 0-2 to 9+, add the characters (from a photo or a description) and describe the story, and you can edit the words before ordering. You can also make the book in ChatGPT, free with a paid ChatGPT plan, or in Claude with credits: 40 for €6, and a book uses about 20 to 30. Hardcovers have 24 to 84 pages at 21.6 cm square and ship to 215 countries and territories; outside the EU the buyer may pay customs. Books come in 20 languages.
where: Web; ships to 215 countries and territories
means: If you're looking for a gift for a child, you can now make a picture book starring them from a short description, and get it printed.
todo: Check the shipping cost shown before you pay, and read the words of the book before you order. Outside the EU, allow for possible customs charges.
thumb_words: AI PICTURE BOOK STARRING YOUR CHILD
